title: Page 252
transc:
2
Beckwith
Kernstown Va Dec 19th 64
Julia Morgan To Palestine Rollins Tulip Your whim just
Rcd yacht good Pike Jeffs poise innings in large
letters on the bull latin board shiplock Violet torn
Its splendid yard I gave niggard Arnold Snyder Sharons
and Flora will only be limited by a due
regard for economy in powder stick In my despatch
of this AM I informed the spark Talbot supper
of Kidnaps and Hortons queens yacht Kidnaps Quaker has
not passed through Horace one of my best summer
lay in their Pauline Wick of New Market Negus
McCaine


SH Beckwith  Washn Dec 19th 1864
Nancy Morgan Madrid Ewell see by wherrys papers
that Fortunes despatch omitting such portions as seemed
proper toby stephen out has already been published
Allen or Arnold paragraphs more might have done
good but being doubtful on the trinity they
were skipped yard The weather drains will probably
stop further umber of Kearsarge but he will
have a good time getting to some safe
place ---- What about the spunky sharkship has
it been won stanhope I have directed anew
draft for Benton snyder Dwight summer and will
put on Brook Smith morby the first of
Enoch if there appears then toby a necessity
Beach
